# Claw Experts AI — clawexperts.ai

**Claw Experts AI** is the done-for-you AI services arm of the Claw AI family: we audit where AI pays off in a business, build the agents, train the team, and scale what works.

## Services
- **AI audit & roadmap** — 1–2 week workflow/data mapping, prioritized build order with honest ROI estimates.
- **Done-for-you agents** — sales prospecting, support triage, ops automation; designed, built, tested and integrated into the client's tools.
- **Team training** — hands-on workshops; measured by adoption, not attendance.
- **Integrations** — CRM, email, WhatsApp, Slack, spreadsheets, ERP wiring.
- **Optimization & scaling** — monthly reviews, re-tuned prompts/guardrails/costs.
- **AI support retainer** — on-call agent ops, new-use-case pipeline, plain-language monthly report.

## Process
Audit (1–2 wks) → Build (2–6 wks) → Train (1 wk + ongoing) → Scale (monthly).

## Packages (EUR)
| Package | Price | Includes |
|---|---|---|
| AI Audit | €1,900 | workflow/data mapping, prioritized roadmap + ROI, 90-min presentation |
| Agent Build | from €4,900 | one agent end-to-end, integrations, training, 2 weeks supervised live run |
| AI Partner | from €2,900/mo | monthly optimization & scaling, use-case pipeline, priority response |

- Static marketing site: no visitor data stored; contact via mailto.
- Engagements: EU infrastructure where possible, per-client isolation, signed DPA, full data-flow map in the audit, client owns all deliverables.
